hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; f="$d/.claude/WORKLOG.md"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo '<worktree-work-log>'; echo 'Persistent record of prior Claude work in this worktree (survives /clear and /compact).
